summary: Navigate a designed stacked maze while retaining an exact cell-and-link path history.
objective: Build a three-level maze with explicit stair links, a movable marker and a slice view for each floor.
example_prompts: Build a three-level maze with explicit stair links, a movable marker and a slice view for each floor.
Let me undo a move and inspect why two visually nearby corridors are not connected.

entities.name: Maze floors
entities.guidance: Use separate slabs and wall segments with consistent corridor widths and visible stair openings.

entities.name: Interlevel links
entities.guidance: Represent stairs or lifts as named paired endpoints, not arbitrary teleport glows.

entities.name: Player marker
entities.guidance: Use a compact upright token with a heading notch and current-cell label.

object_craft.structure: Use separate slabs and wall segments with consistent corridor widths and visible stair openings.
object_craft.material: Muted floor material with distinct level-edge accents.

object_craft.structure: Represent stairs or lifts as named paired endpoints, not arbitrary teleport glows.
object_craft.material: Contrasting treads and directional endpoint signs.

object_craft.structure: Use a compact upright token with a heading notch and current-cell label.

state_contract.model: Authored graph of cells and explicit traversable edges, level index, current cell, goal and path stack; links are authoritative even when projected geometry appears adjacent.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Move along a highlighted valid edge.
Undo step, reset and request a graph-derived hint.

invariants: Every accepted move follows an actual graph edge.
Level changes use declared interlevel links only.
A hint is either a computed path or explicitly unavailable, never an invented arrow.
motion_guidance: Interpolate token along its accepted edge; stair motion uses the link geometry and finishes at the destination cell.
Keep hidden floors in navigation state and show arrival level before completing camera transition.
known_limits: Authored maze with graph movement, not free-body navigation or building evacuation analysis.
Verify connectivity to the goal before claiming the authored start is solvable.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Layer slicing preserves spatial depth while making interlevel choices inspectable.

colliders: Token corridor envelope and explicit edge paths.
driving: Accepted graph edge with bounded travel speed.
contact: No arbitrary wall crossing; graph movement rather than contact solver.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: No cross-level shortcut; undo returns exact prior cell and level.
